title: Micro initiative evidence and sync cues
content:
Purpose: quick catch-all for micro-initiative updates, short evidence snippets I can drop into a manager sync or calibration. Keep it scannable. Not polished — notes to myself.

Top-level objective (Q1 focus): reduce new-hire ramp for eng and data by 15% through onboarding docs + two cohort playbooks.

Concrete micro-initiatives (1-liners):
- New starter checklist: centralize links + 3 blockers to resolve (access, infra onboarding, team pairing).
- 2-hour onboarding office hour pilot: weekly for month 1; measure attendance + follow-up tickets.
- Onboarding quiz + 3 mini tasks to validate environment set-up (git, vpn, repo access).
- Manager primer: 6 talking points for week-1 1:1 (okrs, career convo, expectations, pairing plan, quick wins, escalation path).

6-week evidence snippets (date - short outcome / metric):
- 2026-01-18 - office hour pilot 1: 9 attendees, 7 raised at least one access issue -> created JIRA-3345 to fix DNZ vpn doc.
- 2026-01-25 - quiz pilot: 12 responses, 10/12 completed tasks; median time 14m -> change: add step-by-step screenshot for repo clone.
- 2026-02-03 - new starter checklist published -> 4 teams adopted; feedback: missing onboarding buddy step.
- 2026-02-10 - manager primer draft shared with 5 managers; 3 suggested adding career cheat-sheet -> updated primer v1.1.

Signals to watch (leading/lagging):
- Leading: attendance at office hours, quiz completion rate, number of access tickets opened in week 1.
- Lagging: time to first merged PR, time to first independent deploy, manager satisfaction score at 30 days.

Risks / blockers:
- Infra team bandwidth (ticket backlog pushes doc fixes).
- Manager adoption: primer needs to be <5 min read; otherwise it won't get used.
- Tracking noise: teams use different metrics; need to standardize 3 core metrics.

Quick asks for manager sync (30s lines):
- "I ran a small onboarding pilot; early signs show quiz + office hours reduce basic access issues. Asking for 2 weeks of infra triage time to close DNZ vpn and repo clone screencap doc. That should unblock estimated 10 hires in next quarter."
- "I'd like your help: can you ask Eng managers to commit one buddy per new hire for first 2 weeks? A slack nudge in the manager meeting would help."

Draft 1-line status update for weekly standup: 
- "Onboarding pilot: checklist live, weekly office hours ongoing, quiz >80% completion; infra doc fixes prioritized (JIRA-3345)."

Sample manager prep bullets (for 1:1 agenda slot):
- 1-min recap of pilot + key metric (quiz completion %).
- 1-min ask: infra triage time + manager buddy commitment.
- 2-min discussion: adoption friction (how teams can fit buddy time into calendar).
- 1-min ask for endorsement in manager sync meeting.

Notes to self / todo (short):
- Add a short video (2-3 clips) showing repo clone + environment setup. (follow-up: record with Noah)
- Make checklist printer-friendly + PDF for hiring managers.
- Create a simple dashboard (sheet) with 3 metrics: quiz rate, time-to-first-PR, week-1 access tickets.
- Draft two lines for people-ops town: celebrate early wins + ask for infra help.

Random brain dump — phrases to test in manager message:
- "Small change, big lift: quick office hours + checklist dramatically lower trivial access friction."
- "We can reduce noise in SRE by resolving 3 doc gaps; ROI = fewer interrupts for infra on day-0."

Reference links / IDs (to paste into messages):
- JIRA-3345 (DNZ vpn doc)
- JIRA-3380 (onboarding quiz results sheet)
- confluence://people-ops/onboarding-checklist-v1

Open questions I want to answer before calibration:
- What is realistic target for time-to-first-PR drop in 90 days? (5 days -> 4 days?)
- Which manager will champion buddy program? (ask in sync)
- Do we have capacity to run office hours beyond month 1 if adoption looks strong?

Version notes: draft 0.1 — informal. Keep this doc short, pull highlights into manager slide or one-pager before exec review.

End.
